source_data.report_family: YouTube Analytics API channel user activity by country

monthly_country_filter_report.reason: The documented time-based channel report supports month and a country filter. Do not assume month,country is a supported joint combination.

source_data.revenue_geo_suppression: YouTube says revenue by geography is not limited; other geography/audience metrics may be privacy-suppressed

comparison_types.can_measure: same owner's estimated channel revenue attributed to viewer countries for a stated compatible date range
comparison_types.cannot_measure: income of representative creators residing in each country
median and zero-inclusive net creator earnings across creator-residence populations without a representative owner panel and documented expenses
actual after-expense creator living standard using generic viewer-country earnings, spot FX alone, or arbitrary GDP PPP

purchasing_power.reference: OECD purchasing power parities and comparative price levels
purchasing_power.rule: Dated matching currency base, location, consumer-basket definition, price index and year are essential. No rate may be manufactured or defaulted.

invalid_inferences: Viewer country is not channel owner or creator residence.
Channel language is not audience country, creator nationality or tax residence.
The existence of a monetization feature in a listed country is not creator YPP approval or earnings.
Different currencies, time windows, channels and monetized status cannot be pooled as a creator income distribution.
Country ZZ is unknown geography and must not be assigned to a named market.
Estimated revenue is not bank-deposited cash or after-expense personal income.
Raw ad revenue is not an advertiser gross CPM, creator profit or personal earnings.
FX conversion is not a purchasing-power adjustment and GDP PPP is not automatically an individual-consumption PPP.
Missing privacy-limited geography must not be replaced with inferred user demographics or zero rows.
